# Adopt F# example

F# SDK-style tree with a `greet` package and a stdlib-only `solo` package.

```sh
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- init //fsharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-fsharp/...
bazel run @rules_dx//:dx -- generate //fsharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-fsharp/...
bazel build //fsharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-fsharp/...
bazel test //fsharp/tests/fixtures/adopt-fsharp/...
```

Both tests pass (`greet_test`, `pure_test`).
